privacy.title: Privacy and payments
privacy.intro: What we keep about you, who sees it, and how paying and refunds work on Mabeet.

keep.title: What we keep
keep.body: For your account: your name, your email and your password, stored protected. For a booking: the name and phone number you give the host, and your email if you add it. We ask for nothing else.

see.title: Who sees it
see.body: The place you book sees your contact details, so the host can reach you. Their team members see them only if their role allows it; otherwise your phone and email are partly hidden. Other guests never see them.

calendars.title: Airbnb and Booking.com
calendars.body: The calendar links we share with Airbnb and Booking.com say only which dates are taken, never who booked them or anything about you.

ai.title: AI apps
ai.body: An AI app connected to Mabeet as a guest reads only public places, dates and prices. A host's AI app sees only what that person's role allows, and every use is recorded.

paying.title: Paying online
paying.body: Online payments go through Whish or Stripe. You enter your card or Whish details on their pages: Mabeet never sees or stores them.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.body: A booking paid online on Mabeet is always refunded in full when it is cancelled, whoever cancels, or when the host declines it or does not answer in time. Once the stay has started it can no longer be cancelled, and nights already stayed are not refunded.

direct.title: Paying the host directly
direct.body: Some places ask you to arrange payment with the host. That payment happens outside Mabeet, so it is between you and the host: Mabeet does not record it or refund it.

browser.title: Your browser
browser.body: One cookie keeps you signed in and another remembers your language. Light or dark mode is saved only in your browser. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

rights.title: Your data, your choice
rights.body: From your account you can download everything we hold about you, or delete your account by typing your email. You are signed out everywhere and your email is freed. Your bookings and reviews stay with the host, the reviews without your name.

privacy.headline: Your details stay yours.

useWithAi.title: Use Mabeet from your AI app
useWithAi.headline: Ask your AI app. Get places that are really free.
useWithAi.intro: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or any AI app for a place that is free on your dates. It searches Mabeet for you and links straight to the booking page.
useWithAi.whatBody: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard way for an AI app to use another service's tools. Ours lets your AI app search Mabeet's places and check their dates and prices, live.

about.title: About Mabeet
about.headline: Lebanon's guesthouses, booked direct.
about.intro: Mabeet is where you book a guesthouse, B&B or mountain cabin straight from the people who run it. No platform in the middle taking a cut, and never two guests on one night.

glance.title: Our promises
glance.double: Never two guests on one night

problem.title: What a platform takes from a host
problem.intro: Most Lebanese guesthouses also sell on Airbnb or Booking.com, and every night sold there costs the host a cut.
problem.commission: of every platform booking can go to commission
problem.night: a night can go to commission, on a room at $80
problem.month: a month, for 20 nights sold through a platform
problem.note: Estimates from public prices, at the top of the usual 15 to 18% commission.

how.title: How booking direct works
how.intro: From the host's dashboard to a confirmed night, in four steps.

add.title: The host adds their place
add.body: Rooms, prices per night and photos. The place gets its own booking link for Instagram and WhatsApp.

pick.title: The guest picks dates
pick.body: Nights already booked on Airbnb or Booking.com show as taken, because the calendars stay in sync.

pay.title: Booked and paid in full
pay.body: The guest pays online with Whish or a card, or arranges payment with the host, as the place chooses.

confirm.title: Confirmed everywhere
confirm.body: The host confirms from their phone, and the night closes on Airbnb and Booking.com too.

modes.title: Three ways to take bookings
modes.intro: Each place chooses how it works with its guests.

automatic.title: Automatic
automatic.body: The guest pays online in full, and the booking is confirmed the moment the payment is.

approval.title: Online, with approval
approval.body: The guest pays online in full and the host confirms or declines. No answer in time means a full refund.

offline.title: Arranged with the host
offline.body: No payment through Mabeet: the guest and the host arrange it, and the host confirms by hand.

double.title: Never double-booked
double.body: The database itself refuses two stays on one room night. Not a promise: a rule.

refunds.title: Refunds in full
refunds.body: A booking paid online is refunded in full if it is cancelled, declined or not answered in time.

commission.title: No commission
commission.body: Hosts pay a monthly plan, starting free. The money from every booking is theirs.

data.title: Your details stay yours
data.body: We keep only what a booking needs, and you can download or delete it any time.

band.title: Lebanon is better booked direct.
band.intro: Find your next stay, or bring your place to Mabeet.

contact.headline: Questions? We're here.
contact.intro: Planning a stay or listing your place, the Mabeet team is happy to help.
contact.cardIntro: Send us a message and we'll answer by email.
